text: RESULTS: Liver Function Tests: Bilirubin 25 mg/dL (elevated), AST 600 IU/L (elevated), ALT 650 IU/L (elevated), TP Activity < 40% (reduced), INR 1.5 (elevated). speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the severe jaundice, elevated liver enzymes, asterixis, and coagulopathy, you are showing clear signs of acute liver failure. To distinguish between viral hepatitis and drug-induced injury, I must ask: have you recently taken any prescription medications, over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen, or herbal supplements?
